methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Virginia’s technical workforce faces uncertainty as funding runs out for middle school program
signals.signal_reading: Loss of foundational technical education funding in historically underserved regions signals neither deep AI capability nor broad distribution—youth pipeline collapse widens the preparation gap before AI adoption can even begin.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: A dedicated WorkAI Lab at Roanoke College suggests emerging depth in a mid-tier region, but institutional concentration at a single college signals limited distribution—building excellence without the peer networks for broader diffusion.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native represent grassroots peer-to-peer knowledge transfer aimed at broad fluency—this is distributed capacity-building outside traditional institutional gatekeepers.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Data center concentration analysis explicitly names the urban-rural divide as a consequence of AI infrastructure clustering in NoVA—the infrastructure itself reinforces geographic concentration of both capital and capability.

signals.title: Arlington cyber warfare startup raises $100M, reaches unicorn status
signals.signal_reading: Arlington cyber warfare unicorn reaching $1B valuation demonstrates NoVA's deepening AI-adjacent technical sophistication and capital access—advanced capability clustering in the metro corridor while other regions pursue basic workforce training.
